text:
Situation: Insulin glulisine is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 60 syringes (25.6 days) of 3 mL insulin glulisine. Corvale General holds 277 syringes (23 days). Corvale East holds 268 syringes (26.6 days) of 3 mL insulin glulisine. Corvale East also holds insulin lispro 3 mL syringes at 6.7 days and insulin glargine 1.5 mL syringes at 7.4 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include insulin glulisine as of 2026-10-21. A Baxter Healthcare Corporation plant (FEI 1416980) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2026-04-02 and a Warning Letter on 2026-09-29. Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH (FEI 3003195501) had a VAI inspection ending 2022-03-25 and a prior OAI ending 2010-09-16. Genzyme Corporation (FEI 3009389940) had a NAI inspection ending 2016-08-18. A-S Medication Solutions (FEI 1450743) had a VAI inspection ending 2026-08-12.

Our position: Supply is adequate system-wide. Internal imbalances exist for insulin lispro and insulin glargine at Corvale East. Transfers can resolve these without purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 11 syringes of insulin glulisine 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Transfer 91 syringes of insulin lispro 100 U/mL 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Transfer 33 syringes of insulin glargine 1.5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Transfer 1 syringe of insulin glargine 1.5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Novo Nordisk; the drug is not on FDA's shortage list and current inventory supports internal redistribution.
